transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—thanks for coming. To start, can you tell me what's been bringing you in today?

Hi, thanks. Um, I guess I came in because I feel like I just cannot get my schoolwork and my little accessories shop organized at the same time. It's getting really overwhelming. Like, my shop supplies, due dates for classes, receipts, and all my assignment notes... they all just end up in these huge piles everywhere. And then I look at them and I honestly just don't even know what to do first.
Have you struggled with this kind of disorganization and difficulty prioritizing tasks since you were a kid, or is this something that's really only become a problem recently?

It's definitely been going on since I was a kid. Actually, my mom still has some of my old elementary school notes from teachers. They were always saying how I was constantly out of my seat, or talking before I was called on. And, um, they also said I would always just rush through group activities, even when I completely understood the work. So, yeah, it's definitely not a new thing for me.
Do you currently find yourself losing focus partway through tasks, frequently misplacing things like your keys or paperwork, or forgetting appointments and deadlines?

Yeah, I definitely lose focus partway through things. Like, in class or when I'm watching a video for my business assignments, I can start out listening just fine. But after a few minutes, my mind is already on charm designs or order ideas, and then I realize I missed half of what was actually said.

Right now, as an adult, do you still notice things like feeling restless or fidgety, having trouble staying seated for long periods, or frequently interrupting or blurting things out during conversations?

Yeah, definitely. Um, especially the fidgeting part. Like, when I have to sit through lectures or go to study group meetings, my leg is pretty much always bouncing. Or I'm clicking a pen. A lot of times I'll just be messing with extra beads or key rings in my bag, and I honestly don't even notice I'm doing it until I catch myself. It's just really hard for me to sit completely still.
